Name: Christmas_Miller_Feast_Line
$Comment: Tomas's Christmas line in his Harvest Feast conversation. Christmas starts while the feast's last
days still run, and while the feast runs Tomas stands at his feast spot speaking his feast
conversation (NpcPlacements/Harvest_Feast_Miller_Temple.json takes its feast entry first). This line
lets a player reach his Christmas stall from the first day of Christmas all the same. Once the feast
is over he speaks his Christmas conversation (Dialogues/SeasonsOfOrbis/Christmas_Miller.json), which
opens the stall itself, and the feast conversation is no longer reached.
Dialogues.Ids names his feast conversation alone, since each villager's line opens that villager's
own stall (Christmas_Weaver_Feast_Line and Christmas_Shepherd_Feast_Line do the same for Elsie and
Bram). It lands on the screens the conversation opens on, after a screen's own lines and before the
goodbye group, so goodbye stays last. Season offers it only while Christmas runs; to take it out, set
Enabled false in a file of the same name. The line pays nothing: it opens the stall.
